source: Quiz 4 - Sessions 1-5: Building and Improving Agent Skills
question: What role does the harness play when an agent requests a file operation?

options.text: It invokes an available tool and returns its result.
options.feedback: The harness connects a supported request to an available tool. Returning the result lets the model use evidence from the operation.

options.text: It treats the generated request as a completed operation.
options.feedback: A request expresses an operation to attempt. Execution and checking the outcome still have to happen.

options.text: It stores the learned weights that select the next token.
options.feedback: Learned parameters belong to the model. The harness provides the operating environment that executes supported tool requests.

options.text: It makes a successful tool call count as a verified outcome.
options.feedback: Executing a tool supplies a result to inspect. You still need to check whether that result meets the task requirement.
